name: jtest
title: J test of y on x against y on sqrt(x).

origin.description: J test of y on x against y on sqrt(x).
origin.details: Both J-test rows: estimate, standard error, t, and p-value of the added fitted value.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: J test of y on x against y on sqrt(x).
translation.details: Both J-test rows: estimate, standard error, t, and p-value of the added fitted value.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from lmtest import jtest
import numpy as np
x = np.array([1,3,2,6,5,8,7,4,9,10,12,11,15,13,14,18,16,19,17,20], float)
y = np.array([2,2,4,3,7,6,9,8,5,11,10,14,12,16,15,13,19,17,20,18], float)
z = np.sqrt(x)
print(jtest(y, x, z))
